flags.why: In colloquial Northern Vietnamese, chửa also commonly means 'not yet', which is unrelated to pregnancy.
flags.fix: Add: adverb [colloquial, Northern] | not yet; example: Tôi chửa ăn cơm. = I haven't eaten yet.

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of displaying a skill or talent, as in trổ tài.
flags.fix: Add: verb | to display; to show off (a skill or talent); example: Anh ấy trổ tài nấu ăn. = He showed off his cooking skills.
